function.name: get_accounts
function.description: List the chart of accounts for the current company: account_id, name, account_type.

function.name: get_vendors
function.description: List vendors for the current company, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive name substring.

function.name: get_transactions
function.description: List transactions for the current company, ordered by txn_date then txn_id. Dates are inclusive, format YYYY-MM-DD. Returns at most `limit` rows (default 100).

function.name: sql_query
function.description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT over ledger.accounts, ledger.vendors and ledger.transactions. Rows are automatically restricted to the current company. Returns at most 200 rows.

function.name: create_journal_entry
function.description: Record one journal entry for the current company in a sandbox. Total debits must equal total credits. Returns entry_id.

function.name: submit_answer
function.description: Submit the final answer and end the task. Use `number` for numeric questions, `ids` for questions asking which transactions or vendors, and `entry_ids` after recording journal entries. Call exactly once.
